h1: Building the future of performance marketing
data.text: Home Solutions Why Uplane Resources About Us Careers Login Get Started About Us Building the future of performance marketing AI-first approach to better, faster, and smarter marketing. Founding Story The reason behind our work We’re building Uplane to help marketing teams achieve superior results with significantly less effort, time, and ad spend. Talk to Founders Explore Features We founded Uplane because Marketing desperately needs a revolution. Marketing managers are blocked in slow and endless design cycles. New ads and new landing pages are a constant performance bottleneck. Launching and optimizing campaigns involves countless manual steps in slow and buggy ad management systems. Consumers carry the burden of receiving irrelevant ads every day, and companies even pay billions for that. With Uplane, we fundamentally want to transform the way companies approach performance marketing. Our vision is a marketing engine that operates with true autonomy. A platform that allows you to generate thousands of personalized ads and matching landing pages in seconds, launch them across channels with one click, and autonomously allocate budgets to ensure every penny is invested for maximum impact. We want to give every marketing team an engine that runs hundreds of experiments around the clock, constantly improves, and gets better with every bit of consumer feedback. Founded by a team that has lived the painful inefficiencies of manual marketing and is backed by deep expertise in product development, data analytics and AI, our mission is to give performance marketers true leverage, enabling them to achieve superior results with less effort and spend, and with a whole lot of joy. Leadership We are looking for outstanding talents who want to push the boundaries of Performance Marketing and build nothing less than the future of digital advertising. h1: Hit every customer with the right message
data.text: Home Solutions Why Uplane Resources About Us Careers Login Get Started Why Uplane Uplane vs Traditional Performance Marketing Say goodbye to delays, inefficiencies, and missed opportunities. Discover how Uplane wins, every time. Talk to Founders Explore Features A day in your life Do you know these situations? Your CPA goes bust again So, you begin creating and publishing new ads. Finding new best performers through A/B testing costs even more time and money. Instead of reacting when it’s already too late, you should be testing and iterating all the time. Talk to Founders You found a best performer Congrats. But what happens next? Scale? Yes. But how much and which channel? Uplane perfectly allocates your budget across channels and ad groups so that you reach the largest possible audience at the best price. Talk to Founders Hit every customer with the right message You know you should be tailoring your winning ads for different audiences. But the reality is that creating, tracking, and managing all those variations is impossible. Uplane not only creates personalized variations of your best ads for different audiences, but also handles campaign deployment and management across your channels for optimal conversion. Talk to Founders Be more creative than ever How do you find new ad ideas? You read through countless blogs, check ad libraries, maybe even spy on your colleagues. Uplane constantly scans the web for relevant topics, analyzes your best performing ads ever, and checks out your competitors’ marketing. Uplane means creativity at scale. Talk to Founders Relax on weekends How many times have you returned from a weekend only to find your budget was wasted on underperforming ads? Uplane automatically monitors and allocates your budget so you can finally really disconnect. Consider weekend emergency adjustments a problem of the past. Talk to Founders Lead Quantity Rollercoaster Is your lead volume a rollercoaster of highs and lows? One week the sales team has too many leads, the next they're complaining about a drought. Uplane intelligently allocates your budget to maintain a stable, predictable flow of high-quality leads. Talk to Founders Design Bottleneck Still waiting for the next alignment meeting with your design team to explain them the ad idea you had last week? With Uplane, this process takes minutes instead of days. Open the Slack app, drop your idea, and get ads created and deployed in seconds. Talk to Founders What’s My ROAS Anyway? If you don’t know your numbers, you’re flying blind. Manual tracking across channels, campaigns and countless spreadsheets is a nightmare. Let’s change that. Uplane gives you clear transparency over which creatives, channels, topics and wordings work best, all in an instant, all in one place. Talk to Founders Win GPT Battles You have a great idea. You feed it into your favourite AI-Model, but it doesn’t get it. You iterate and wait. The result is still off. Uplane is different. It’s built to understand your brand’s design, tone, and image language, delivering what you envisioned from the start. And if you have further ideas, you can fine-tune it in seconds. Talk to Founders Uplane’s Edge Summary Built to Perform. Powered by AI. Uplane doesn’t just help it works for you, 24/7. With every feature tailored to optimize performance marketing end-to-end. data.text: Home Solutions Why Uplane Resources About Us Careers Login Get Started Last Updated: June 02, 2026 Privacy Policy Introduction Welcome to Uplane, Inc. (“Uplane,” “we,” “us,” or “our”). We operate a SaaS platform designed to help businesses manage their marketing efforts, including ad generation, landing page generation, and ad cost management (the “Service”). This Privacy Policy describes how Uplane collects, uses, discloses, and safeguards your information when you visit our website, uplane.com (the “Website”), and when you use our Service. This document also includes our Cookie Policy, detailing our use of cookies and similar technologies. We are committed to protecting your privacy and personal data in compliance with applicable data protection laws, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) for individuals in the European Economic Area (EEA), the United Kingdom (UK), and Switzerland, and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA) for California consumers. Please read this Privacy Policy carefully. If you do not agree with the terms of this Privacy Policy, please do not access the Website or use our Service. 1) Who We Are Uplane, Inc. is an Inc. registered in Delaware, with our principal place of business at 1111B S Governors Ave STE 40514, Dover, DE 19904. For the purpose of providing our Website and Service directly to you (our customer), Uplane acts as a Data Controller over certain personal data we collect from you (e.g., your account details, billing information). When our customers use the Uplane Service to process personal data of their end-users (e.g., collecting lead data on landing pages, tracking ad performance for campaigns), Uplane typically acts as a Data Processor on behalf of our customers. In such cases, our customers are the Data Controllers and are responsible for ensuring they have the necessary legal bases and notices in place. We have separate Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) with our customers to govern these processing activities. 2) What Information We Collect About You We collect various types of information from and about you to provide and improve our Website and Service. a. Information You Voluntarily Provide to Us: When you register for an account, subscribe to our Service, contact support, or interact with our Website, you may provide us with the following personal data: Account & Contact Information: Your name, company name, email address, postal address, phone number, username, and password. Payment & Billing Information: Credit card numbers, billing address, bank account details (collected and processed by our third-party payment processors; we typically do not store full payment card details ourselves). Profile Information: Your job title, industry, and other professional details provided to customize your Uplane experience. Communications: Records of your correspondence with us, including customer support inquiries, feedback, survey responses, and interactions on social media. User-Generated Content: Any information, text, images, or other content you upload, create, or manage through the Uplane Service (e.g., ad copy, landing page content, campaign settings). b. Information We Collect Automatically: When you visit our Website or use our Service, we automatically collect certain information about your device and usage through cookies and similar technologies: Log Data: Your Internet Protocol (IP) address, browser type and version, operating system, referring/exit pages, access times, pages viewed, and the duration of your visit. Device Information: Device type, unique device identifiers, device settings, and mobile network information. Usage Data: Information about how you use our Website and Service, such as features you interact with, searches performed, marketing campaigns launched, and other activity within your Uplane account. Performance Data: Metrics related to the performance and stability of our Service to identify and resolve issues. c. Information We Collect from Third Parties: We may receive information about you from third-party sources to enhance our Service or your experience: Authentication Partners: If you choose to log in through a third-party authentication service (e.g., Google Single Sign-On), we may receive certain profile information from that service. Analytics & Advertising Partners: Data from advertising networks or analytics providers about your interactions with our ads or services. Marketing & Sales Partners: Information from partners who refer you to our Service. Integrated Platforms: When you connect third-party platforms to your Uplane account (e.g., ad platforms like Google Ads, Facebook Ads; CRM systems), we receive data from those platforms as authorized by you to provide the Service. This data, which may include ad campaign performance, ad cost data, lead data from landing pages, is processed by us on your behalf as a Data Processor. 3) How We Use Your Information We use the information we collect for various business and commercial purposes to operate, improve, and personalize our Website and Service, specifically as a Data Controller for our direct customer data: To Provide and Maintain Our Service: To register and manage your Uplane account. To process your subscriptions, payments, and deliver the features of our marketing management platform. To enable ad generation, landing page creation, ad cost tracking, and other functionalities you utilize. To provide technical support and respond to your inquiries. To Improve and Personalize Your Experience: To analyze how you use our Website and Service to identify areas for improvement. To develop new features, products, and services relevant to marketing management. To customize your Uplane dashboard and provide tailored recommendations or content. For Marketing and Advertising: To send you promotional communications, newsletters, and special offers about Uplane’s products and services, where you have opted in or where we have a legitimate interest. To conduct targeted advertising for Uplane’s own services on third-party platforms. To measure the effectiveness of our marketing campaigns. For Analytics and Research: To monitor and analyze trends, usage patterns, and activities in connection with our Service. To conduct internal research and development to enhance our platform. For Security and Fraud Prevention: To protect our Website, Service, and users from fraudulent activities, unauthorized access, and security breaches. To ensure the integrity of our platform and data. To Comply with Legal Obligations: To fulfill our legal and regulatory requirements, such as tax reporting or responding to lawful requests from public authorities. For Business Transfers: In connection with any merger, sale of company assets, financing, or acquisition of all or a portion of our business by another company. 4) How We Share Your Information We may share your personal data with third parties in the following situations, always ensuring appropriate safeguards are in place: With Service Providers: We engage third-party companies and individuals to facilitate our Service, provide services on our behalf, perform Website-related services, or assist us in analyzing how our Service is used. These service providers act as our Data Processors and are bound by contractual obligations to protect your data and only use it for the purposes we specify. Examples include cloud hosting providers, payment processors, customer support and communication platforms, analytics providers, and email marketing and CRM providers. With Integrated Platforms (as your Processor): When you choose to connect your Uplane account with third-party advertising platforms (e.g., Google Ads, Facebook Ads), CRM systems, or other marketing tools, we will share and receive data with those platforms as instructed by you to provide the Service you configured. This is done on your behalf as a Data Processor, and your privacy settings on those platforms, as well as our Data Processing Agreements with you, will govern this. For Business Transfers: In connection with, or during negotiations of, any merger, sale of company assets, financing, or acquisition of all or a portion of our business by another company. With Affiliates: We may share your information with our current or future affiliates, in which case we will require those affiliates to honor this Privacy Policy. For Legal Reasons: We may disclose your information if required to do so by law or in the good faith belief that such action is necessary to (i) comply with a legal obligation (e.g., court order, subpoena), (ii) protect and defend our rights or property, (iii) prevent or investigate possible wrongdoing in connection with the Service, (iv) protect the personal safety of users of the Service or the public, or (v) protect against legal liability. data.text: Home Solutions Why Uplane Resources About Us Careers Login Get Started Back Performance Marketing Welcome to Uplane AI is changing marketing forever. We share our vision of the future of marketing. Welcome to Uplane If you haven’t noticed, AI is changing marketing forever. It’s becoming hyper-relevant, hyper-fast, and hyper-precise. We see it every day as consumers: the perfect show Netflix suggests, the custom playlist Spotify builds just for us. We're getting used to this level of personalization, and soon, we'll expect it from every brand we interact with. But for the teams behind those brands, meeting that expectation feels nearly impossible. They're stuck battling: Manual, time-consuming design processes Clunky dependencies on tech teams Buggy and inefficient ad management tools This makes it unfeasible to create and launch the sheer volume and quality of content that modern marketing demands. The Real Reason Your Ads Aren't Working For decades, marketing has been trapped by a painful paradox. The technology to reach the right person, at the right time, on the right channel is already here. The real challenge, the one draining budgets and stalling growth, is having the perfect creative to show them. This isn't a small problem. According to a Nielsen study, creative quality is responsible for 47% of an ad's contribution to sales. Think about that. The creative is more important than targeting, reach, and brand combined. This leaves even the best marketers in a constant state of compromise. They’re forced to run generic campaigns for specific audiences, wasting billions on ads that fail to connect. This creative bottleneck is the wall standing between every company and its true potential. What if you could finally break through? From Broadcast to AI: The Final Stage of Marketing Marketing has evolved in distinct stages: The Broadcast Era: One message for everyone. Radio, TV, and print blanketed the masses with the same story. The Digital Era: Targeted audiences, but generic creative. Platforms like Meta and Google let us find the right people, but not speak to them in a truly personal way. The AI Era: Hyper-personalized marketing at scale. Now, creative and targeting finally merge. Every individual can see the message that resonates most with them, delivered at the perfect moment. We are entering the final stage of marketing. And this is exactly where Uplane comes in. Uplane: Your Autonomous Growth Engine We are building the future of marketing by transforming your biggest bottleneck into your most powerful competitive advantage. Our platform functions like a full-stack marketing team with unlimited resources for creativity and precision. Here’s how it works: It Analyzes: Uplane’s AI decodes what truly drives performance, analyzing thousands of variables from competitor campaigns, viral trends, and your own real-time data. It Creates: It then generates hundreds of ad variations with perfectly matched landing pages each tailored to a specific audience and channel. It Optimizes: Uplane deploys these assets, measures every interaction, and automatically reallocates your budget to the winning combinations, ensuring every dollar is invested for maximum impact. Uplane eliminates guesswork with data, and makes on-brand content production lightning fast. Instead of testing one ad at a time, now, marketers test tens or even hundreds of ads and landing pages simultaneously, leading to real, measurable business impact. With Uplane, marketing is finally fun again Beyond saving billions in ad spend, Uplane gives marketers back the part of their job they love most. Instead of being trapped in endless design cycles and struggling with unreliable tools, marketers can finally: Bring brilliant ideas to life in seconds. Ship their ideas to consumers lightning-fast, on the right channel, at the right time. Truly understand and connect with their audiences. With Uplane, marketing is finally fun again. It's creative, fast, and endlessly impactful. Are you curious to see how it could work for your brand? Book Your Demo Now Ready to upgrade your marketing? Ready to upgrade your marketing?
